csv_agency: Bad River Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Indians
csv_scope_of_work: The Bad River Tribe seeks Architecture and Engineering Services for a new construction Native Boys and Girls Club building. The Bad River Tribe recognizes the need for a new facility to house the Boys and Girls Club Program it operates on Reservation. The aging facility now in use has serious defects that cannot be remedied in a cost-effective manner. This RFP is meant to provide prospective A / E firms or teams with sufficient information to prepare and submit proposals for architectural and engineering services during design development, construction documents, bidding, and construction administration.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering
